adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action allows `categoryId` to be `null` (no guard; `cantSave` only checks `host` and `host.isSaving`). The server controller (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) explicitly defaults a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`, but the client-side success handler does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` using the *pre-save* `categoryId`. If `categoryId` is `null`, `findById(null)` will yield `undefined` and the UI will show a blank/stale category badge despite the record being saved with a real category_id on the server. The “in-flight guard” concern is plausible but not fully verifiable from the diff alone; the category mismatch is directly grounded in the code paths shown.
